title: Two-coordinate affine remainder
statement: Given $a_0\in\mathbb R$, coefficients $a_k\in\mathbb R$ for $k$ in a set of $n$ coordinates, coordinates $i,j$, and a sign vector $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, the two-coordinate affine remainder is $a_0+\sum_{k\ne i,\ k\ne j}a_k x_k$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ assigns a real coefficient to each of the $n$ coordinates
$i$ and $j$ are coordinates among the $n$ coordinates
$x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
